latHint: Think bragging about a win - not a black bird.
pivHint: A CROW is a large black bird - but to CROW about your win means to do what?
winText: Full of yourself. CROW was the pivot - a black bird to BOASTing.
lossText: BOAST - to brag. CROW was the pivot: a blackbird CROW to CROWing about a win.
